<svg viewBox="0 0 900 360" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="900" height="360" fill="#F0F4F3"/>

  <!-- title -->
  <text x="20" y="30" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#17232C">하지불안증후군(RLS) 병태생리 흐름</text>

  <!-- arrows (drawn under boxes) -->
  <g fill="none" stroke="#0B5F5E" stroke-width="2">
    <path d="M170,191 C 206,191 212,102 244,102"/>
    <path d="M170,191 C 206,191 212,280 244,280"/>
    <path d="M440,102 C 460,126 460,160 464,178"/>
    <path d="M440,280 C 460,256 460,222 464,204"/>
    <path d="M665,191 L 694,191"/>
  </g>
  <g fill="#0B5F5E">
    <polygon points="250,102 242,97 242,107"/>
    <polygon points="250,280 242,275 242,285"/>
    <polygon points="470,178 462,173 462,183"/>
    <polygon points="470,204 462,199 462,209"/>
    <polygon points="700,191 692,186 692,196"/>
  </g>

  <!-- branch hint -->
  <text x="205" y="186" font-size="12" fill="#6B7680" text-anchor="middle">이중</text>
  <text x="205" y="200" font-size="12" fill="#6B7680" text-anchor="middle">경로</text>

  <!-- Box 1: iron deficiency -->
  <rect x="20" y="154" width="150" height="74" rx="10" fill="#E3EFEE" stroke="#0B5F5E" stroke-width="1.8"/>
  <text x="95" y="186" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#17232C" text-anchor="middle">뇌 국소 철분 결핍</text>
  <text x="95" y="206" font-size="12" fill="#6B7680" text-anchor="middle">중추 철 항상성 장애</text>

  <!-- Box 2a: dopamine -->
  <rect x="250" y="68" width="190" height="68" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#0E7C7B" stroke-width="1.8"/>
  <text x="345" y="98" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#17232C" text-anchor="middle">도파민 신호 이상</text>
  <text x="345" y="118" font-size="12" fill="#6B7680" text-anchor="middle">D2 하향조절 · 주기 변동</text>

  <!-- Box 2b: adenosine -->
  <rect x="250" y="246" width="190" height="68" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#0E7C7B" stroke-width="1.8"/>
  <text x="345" y="276" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#17232C" text-anchor="middle">아데노신 신호 ↓</text>
  <text x="345" y="296" font-size="12" fill="#6B7680" text-anchor="middle">A1 수용체 하향조절</text>

  <!-- Box 3: glutamate/dopamine hyperexcitation -->
  <rect x="470" y="150" width="195" height="82" rx="10" fill="#F6EAE8" stroke="#A8352A" stroke-width="1.8"/>
  <text x="567" y="180" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#17232C" text-anchor="middle">글루타메이트 · 도파민</text>
  <text x="567" y="200" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#A8352A" text-anchor="middle">과흥분</text>
  <text x="567" y="219" font-size="12" fill="#6B7680" text-anchor="middle">피질 각성 · 회로 과활성</text>

  <!-- Box 4: nocturnal symptoms / PLMS -->
  <rect x="700" y="150" width="185" height="82" rx="10" fill="#F6EAE8" stroke="#A8352A" stroke-width="1.8"/>
  <text x="792" y="180" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#17232C" text-anchor="middle">야간 감각-운동 증상</text>
  <text x="792" y="200" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#A8352A" text-anchor="middle">· PLMS</text>
  <text x="792" y="219" font-size="12" fill="#6B7680" text-anchor="middle">주기적 사지운동 · 휴식 시 악화</text>

  <!-- drug target hints -->
  <g stroke="#9A6800" stroke-width="1.2">
    <line x1="95" y1="228" x2="95" y2="238" stroke-dasharray="2,2"/>
    <line x1="567" y1="232" x2="567" y2="240" stroke-dasharray="2,2"/>
    <line x1="345" y1="314" x2="345" y2="320" stroke-dasharray="2,2"/>
  </g>
  <rect x="40" y="238" width="110" height="24" rx="12" fill="#FBF3E0" stroke="#9A6800" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <text x="95" y="254" font-size="13" fill="#9A6800" text-anchor="middle">철분 보충</text>

  <rect x="507" y="240" width="120" height="24" rx="12" fill="#FBF3E0" stroke="#9A6800" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <text x="567" y="256" font-size="13" fill="#9A6800" text-anchor="middle">α2δ 리간드</text>

  <rect x="280" y="320" width="130" height="24" rx="12" fill="#FBF3E0" stroke="#9A6800" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <text x="345" y="336" font-size="13" fill="#9A6800" text-anchor="middle">dipyridamole</text>
</svg>
caption: 뇌 국소 철분 결핍이 도파민 신호 이상과 아데노신 신호 저하의 이중 경로로 갈라져 글루타메이트·도파민 과흥분을 일으키고, 결과적으로 야간 감각-운동 증상과 주기적 사지운동(PLMS)으로 이어지는 흐름. 각 단계의 표적 약물(철분 보충 · α2δ 리간드 · dipyridamole)을 황색 태그로 표시.

<svg viewBox="0 0 900 360" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-label="도파민 작용제 augmentation 개념 타임라인">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="sev" gradientUnits="userSpaceOnUse" x1="84" y1="0" x2="582" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#2E7D32"/>
      <stop offset="0.30" stop-color="#2E7D32"/>
      <stop offset="0.52" stop-color="#9A6800"/>
      <stop offset="0.74" stop-color="#A8352A"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#A8352A"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="900" height="360" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Header -->
  <text x="40" y="30" font-size="18" font-weight="700" fill="#17232C">도파민 작용제 Augmentation — 시간 경과에 따른 증상 악화</text>
  <text x="40" y="50" font-size="13" fill="#6B7680">치료 시작 시 호전 → 수개월~수년 후 더 이른 시간·더 넓은 부위·더 강하게 악화</text>

  <!-- Panels -->
  <rect x="40" y="60" width="560" height="222" rx="10" fill="#F0F4F3" stroke="#0E7C7B" stroke-opacity="0.15"/>
  <rect x="616" y="60" width="268" height="222" rx="10" fill="#F0F4F3" stroke="#0E7C7B" stroke-opacity="0.15"/>

  <!-- Y axis label -->
  <text x="26" y="172" font-size="12" fill="#6B7680" text-anchor="middle" transform="rotate(-90 26 172)">증상 심각도</text>

  <!-- Baseline -->
  <line x1="76" y1="172" x2="562" y2="172" stroke="#6B7680" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="5 4" stroke-opacity="0.7"/>
  <text x="560" y="166" font-size="11" fill="#6B7680" text-anchor="end">치료 전 기준선</text>

  <!-- Severity curve -->
  <path d="M84,168 C118,214 158,232 232,232 C292,232 322,226 352,208 C398,180 432,142 474,116 C512,96 548,94 582,90" fill="none" stroke="url(#sev)" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- 1) Improvement -->
  <circle cx="232" cy="232" r="5" fill="#2E7D32"/>
  <line x1="168" y1="216" x2="226" y2="230" stroke="#2E7D32" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <text x="86" y="214" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#2E7D32">① 초기 호전</text>

  <!-- 2) Worsening -->
  <text x="248" y="150" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#A8352A">② 수개월~수년 후 악화</text>
  <line x1="372" y1="190" x2="456" y2="104" stroke="#A8352A" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <polygon points="456,104 452,117 443,108" fill="#A8352A"/>

  <!-- X axis -->
  <line x1="72" y1="256" x2="590" y2="256" stroke="#6B7680" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <polygon points="581,251 581,261 591,256" fill="#6B7680"/>
  <line x1="100" y1="256" x2="100" y2="261" stroke="#6B7680" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <line x1="290" y1="256" x2="290" y2="261" stroke="#6B7680" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <line x1="480" y1="256" x2="480" y2="261" stroke="#6B7680" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <text x="100" y="273" font-size="12.5" fill="#17232C" text-anchor="middle">시작 시</text>
  <text x="290" y="273" font-size="12.5" fill="#17232C" text-anchor="middle">수개월</text>
  <text x="480" y="273" font-size="12.5" fill="#17232C" text-anchor="middle">수년 후</text>

  <!-- Vicious cycle: 용량↑ → 악화 -->
  <text x="445" y="172" font-size="12.5" font-weight="700" fill="#A8352A" text-anchor="middle">악순환</text>
  <rect x="406" y="182" width="78" height="24" rx="6" fill="#9A6800" fill-opacity="0.14" stroke="#9A6800" stroke-opacity="0.55" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <text x="445" y="199" font-size="12.5" font-weight="700" fill="#9A6800" text-anchor="middle">용량 ↑</text>
  <rect x="406" y="226" width="78" height="24" rx="6" fill="#A8352A" fill-opacity="0.12" stroke="#A8352A" stroke-opacity="0.55" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <text x="445" y="243" font-size="12.5" font-weight="700" fill="#A8352A" text-anchor="middle">증상 악화</text>
  <line x1="424" y1="207" x2="424" y2="223" stroke="#9A6800" stroke-width="2"/>
  <polygon points="420,220 428,220 424,227" fill="#9A6800"/>
  <line x1="466" y1="225" x2="466" y2="209" stroke="#A8352A" stroke-width="2"/>
  <polygon points="462,212 470,212 466,205" fill="#A8352A"/>

  <!-- α2δ 전환: escape the cycle -->
  <path d="M484,238 L520,238 L520,288" fill="none" stroke="#0E7C7B" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <polygon points="515,283 525,283 520,291" fill="#0E7C7B"/>
  <text x="528" y="238" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#0B5F5E">α2δ 전환</text>

  <!-- Right panel: 3 features -->
  <text x="632" y="86" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#17232C">악화의 3가지 양상</text>
  <line x1="628" y1="96" x2="872" y2="96" stroke="#6B7680" stroke-opacity="0.3" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- row 1 -->
  <circle cx="650" cy="128" r="15" fill="#9A6800" fill-opacity="0.15" stroke="#9A6800" stroke-opacity="0.5"/>
  <line x1="650" y1="136" x2="650" y2="124" stroke="#9A6800" stroke-width="2.4"/>
  <polygon points="644,125 656,125 650,119" fill="#9A6800"/>
  <text x="676" y="126" font-size="13.5" font-weight="700" fill="#17232C">더 이른 시간대</text>
  <text x="676" y="144" font-size="11.5" fill="#6B7680">낮 시간에도 증상 발생</text>

  <!-- row 2 -->
  <circle cx="650" cy="178" r="15" fill="#9A6800" fill-opacity="0.15" stroke="#9A6800" stroke-opacity="0.5"/>
  <line x1="650" y1="186" x2="650" y2="174" stroke="#9A6800" stroke-width="2.4"/>
  <polygon points="644,175 656,175 650,169" fill="#9A6800"/>
  <text x="676" y="176" font-size="13.5" font-weight="700" fill="#17232C">더 넓은 부위</text>
  <text x="676" y="194" font-size="11.5" fill="#6B7680">팔·몸통까지 확산</text>

  <!-- row 3 -->
  <circle cx="650" cy="228" r="15" fill="#A8352A" fill-opacity="0.15" stroke="#A8352A" stroke-opacity="0.5"/>
  <line x1="650" y1="236" x2="650" y2="224" stroke="#A8352A" stroke-width="2.4"/>
  <polygon points="644,225 656,225 650,219" fill="#A8352A"/>
  <text x="676" y="226" font-size="13.5" font-weight="700" fill="#17232C">더 강한 강도</text>
  <text x="676" y="244" font-size="11.5" fill="#6B7680">증상 심각도 증가</text>

  <text x="632" y="270" font-size="11" fill="#6B7680">* 도파민제 장기 사용의 역설적 현상</text>

  <!-- Bottom action strip -->
  <rect x="40" y="292" width="844" height="54" rx="10" fill="#0E7C7B"/>
  <text x="60" y="316" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">대응: α2δ 리간드로 전환</text>
  <text x="60" y="335" font-size="12.5" fill="#FFFFFF">도파민제 감량·중단 후 gabapentin / pregabalin 전환으로 「용량↑ → 악화」 악순환 차단</text>
</svg>
caption: 도파민 작용제 augmentation은 치료 초기 호전 후 수개월~수년에 걸쳐 증상이 더 이른 시간대·더 넓은 부위·더 강하게 악화되며, 용량 증량이 악화를 부르는 악순환을 형성한다 — 핵심 대응은 α2δ 리간드로의 전환이다.

<svg viewBox="0 0 900 360" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" font-family="sans-serif">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="900" height="360" fill="#F0F4F3"/>

  <!-- Title block (top-left) -->
  <text x="24" y="44" font-size="18" font-weight="700" fill="#17232C">RLS 치료 사다리</text>
  <text x="24" y="66" font-size="13" fill="#6B7680">IRLSSG 근거 · 단계적 · 개별화 접근</text>
  <text x="24" y="90" font-size="12.5" fill="#0B5F5E">낮은 단계 우선, 반응 부족 시 상향 ↗</text>
  <text x="612" y="60" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#0B5F5E">치료 강도 상향 →</text>

  <!-- Step connectors (up-right arrows) -->
  <g stroke="#0B5F5E" stroke-width="2.5" fill="#0B5F5E">
    <line x1="176" y1="282" x2="187" y2="250"/>
    <polygon points="188,248 189.4,259.1 180,255.7" stroke="none"/>
    <line x1="356" y1="248" x2="367" y2="216"/>
    <polygon points="368,214 369.4,225.1 360,221.7" stroke="none"/>
    <line x1="536" y1="214" x2="547" y2="182"/>
    <polygon points="548,180 549.4,191.1 540,187.7" stroke="none"/>
    <line x1="716" y1="180" x2="727" y2="148"/>
    <polygon points="728,146 729.4,157.1 720,153.7" stroke="none"/>
  </g>

  <!-- STEP 1 : 진단 -->
  <g>
    <rect x="8" y="236" width="168" height="92" rx="12" fill="#17232C"/>
    <circle cx="32" cy="261" r="14" fill="#F0F4F3"/>
    <text x="32" y="266" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#17232C" text-anchor="middle">1</text>
    <text x="54" y="266" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#F0F4F3">진단</text>
    <text x="22" y="290" font-size="13" fill="#F0F4F3">IRLSSG 5개 필수기준</text>
    <text x="22" y="307" font-size="13" fill="#F0F4F3">ferritin · TSAT 검사</text>
    <text x="22" y="324" font-size="13" fill="#F0F4F3">이차성 원인 감별</text>
  </g>

  <!-- STEP 2 : 철분 교정 (기반) -->
  <g>
    <rect x="188" y="202" width="168" height="92" rx="12" fill="#0B5F5E"/>
    <circle cx="212" cy="227" r="14" fill="#F0F4F3"/>
    <text x="212" y="232" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#0B5F5E" text-anchor="middle">2</text>
    <text x="234" y="232" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#F0F4F3">철분 교정</text>
    <text x="202" y="256" font-size="13" fill="#F0F4F3">기반 치료 (전 단계)</text>
    <text x="202" y="273" font-size="13" fill="#F0F4F3">ferritin<75 → 보충</text>
    <text x="202" y="290" font-size="13" fill="#F0F4F3">경구 / 정맥(FCM)</text>
  </g>

  <!-- STEP 3 : α2δ 리간드 (1차) -->
  <g>
    <rect x="368" y="168" width="168" height="92" rx="12" fill="#0E7C7B"/>
    <circle cx="392" cy="193" r="14" fill="#F0F4F3"/>
    <text x="392" y="198" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#0E7C7B" text-anchor="middle">3</text>
    <text x="414" y="198" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#F0F4F3">α2δ 리간드</text>
    <text x="382" y="222" font-size="13" fill="#F0F4F3">1차 약물</text>
    <text x="382" y="239" font-size="13" fill="#F0F4F3">gabapentin enacarbil</text>
    <text x="382" y="256" font-size="13" fill="#F0F4F3">pregabalin · gabapentin</text>
  </g>

  <!-- STEP 4 : 도파민 작용제 (후순위) -->
  <g>
    <rect x="548" y="134" width="168" height="92" rx="12" fill="#2E7D32" stroke="#9A6800" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="572" cy="159" r="14" fill="#F0F4F3"/>
    <text x="572" y="164" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#2E7D32" text-anchor="middle">4</text>
    <text x="594" y="164" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#F0F4F3">도파민 작용제</text>
    <text x="562" y="188" font-size="13" fill="#F0F4F3">후순위 · 제한적 사용</text>
    <rect x="562" y="195" width="9" height="9" rx="1.5" fill="#9A6800"/>
    <text x="576" y="204" font-size="13" fill="#F0F4F3">증강현상 위험 ↑</text>
    <text x="562" y="221" font-size="13" fill="#F0F4F3">저용량 · 단기 요법</text>
  </g>

  <!-- STEP 5 : 난치성 -->
  <g>
    <rect x="728" y="100" width="168" height="92" rx="12" fill="#2E7D32" stroke="#A8352A" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="752" cy="125" r="14" fill="#F0F4F3"/>
    <text x="752" y="130" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#2E7D32" text-anchor="middle">5</text>
    <text x="774" y="130" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#F0F4F3">난치성</text>
    <rect x="828" y="113" width="60" height="18" rx="9" fill="#A8352A"/>
    <text x="858" y="126" font-size="11" fill="#F0F4F3" text-anchor="middle">의뢰 고려</text>
    <text x="742" y="154" font-size="13" fill="#F0F4F3">dipyridamole</text>
    <text x="742" y="171" font-size="13" fill="#F0F4F3">저용량 오피오이드</text>
    <text x="742" y="188" font-size="13" fill="#F0F4F3">TOMAC(경피 신경자극)</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Foundation note -->
  <line x1="8" y1="338" x2="896" y2="338" stroke="#0B5F5E" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="452" y="354" font-size="12.5" fill="#0B5F5E" text-anchor="middle">기반(전 단계 공통): 유발약물 검토 · 수면위생 · ferritin/TSAT 정기 재평가</text>
</svg>
caption: 불응성 하지불안증후군(RLS)의 5단계 치료 사다리: 진단(IRLSSG 5기준 + ferritin) → 철분 교정(기반) → α2δ 리간드(1차) → 도파민 작용제(후순위 · 증강현상 주의) → 난치성(dipyridamole · 저용량 오피오이드 · TOMAC). 색은 단계 상향(진한색→녹색)을, 하단 띠는 전 단계 공통 기반관리를 나타낸다.
